'''Corso Riggs's uncle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] with [[Rona Riggs's mother|his wife]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the father of [[Rona Riggs]] and the uncle of [[Corso Riggs]]. When dating offworlders, Rona had her cousin run interference to avoid being caught by her father. When Corso left home to join the [[Peace Brigade (Cold War)|Peace Brigade]], Rona left home with him. During the [[Separatist War]] on Ord Mantell he and his wife were killed by the Separatist forces.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corso Riggs's uncle is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Corso Riggs companion mission.
